note: The v2 happy path for a Continuous Improvement: one rich message states the problem, a solution and why it matters, so the structured fields should all fill from it. A miss on Problem or Proposed solutions means the prompt is still writing one block of prose; a miss on the tag means it is not matching the organization's vocabulary.
turns: The calibration step on the assembly line takes about 40 minutes a unit because each tech works from a paper checklist by hand, and the sheets get lost. A guided digital checklist that logged results automatically would cut it to maybe 15 minutes and keep the records.
